name: The Game Header Fits (13 languages × 3 modes + killer × 360/320px × font 1/1.3)
note: Added 2026-09-30 after a sweep found 54 of 156 header cases broken: buttons pushed off screen, badge text cut mid-word. The mutations put each of the three causes back.

mutations.name: the mode badge sizes itself to its longest word again
mutations.why: The original cause. As a plain flex item the badge could not get narrower than its longest word (「SOBREVIVÊNCIA」, 「CONTRE-LA-MONTRE」 grown 1.3x), and the title group could not shrink past it, so the theme, sound and settings buttons were what moved — off the right edge. First written as removing min-width from the title group, which SURVIVED: with the badge fixed, that alone was never the cause. Then it SURVIVED a second time, for a different reason: the title group can now shrink, so the old badge spilled over the buttons instead of pushing them — covered, not off screen. The gate gained an overlap check for that.

mutations.name: the status badges go back to one line
mutations.why: nowrap in a fixed-height, overflow:hidden badge is what cut 「Ошибка 0 (+10с)」 mid-word. Nothing marks the cut, so the player just reads half a word.

mutations.name: the title shrinks along with the mode badge
mutations.why: Both shrinking took two pixels off "Sudoku" in French at 360px and the normal font — an ellipsis on the most ordinary phone. Rule 3 of the gate exists for exactly this.

mutations.name: a killer's header loses its own badge
mutations.why: Added 2026-10-01 with the killer case. The badge falls back to the mode name, so a killer game says CLASSIC in its header, and the killer case measures the classic header a fourth time. The gate compares the killer badge with the classic one of the same language.
mutations.expectFailure: the classic badge — not its own
